recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of five men in a V-formation against a solid blue backdrop, wearing matching oversized blue suits and black turtlenecks, featuring sharp geometric typography in the upper left corner integrated with horizontal speed lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic blue-on-blue color harmony between subjects and background
V-shaped spatial arrangement creating depth and focus on the central figure
Contrast between the soft studio lighting on skin tones and the sharp, aggressive angles of the graphic elements
Repetition of oversized tailoring creating a unified group identity
coreInvariants: High-contrast studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a staggered V-formation, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure standing slightly forward, framed by the other four members.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the sharp logo in the top left, follows the speed lines across, then drops down to the central figure and radiates outward to the flanking members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open blue space in the upper right and around the perimeter to allow the subjects to breathe.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (turtlenecks, lapel details, and speed lines)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and magenta (typography and small graphic accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue with deep black shadows; skin tones provide the only warm organic break in the cool palette.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to blue, black, white, and a single magenta accent.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical strokes extending into horizontal speed lines
Small triangular magenta accents placed at mid-height junctions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom mark; no secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical density and condensed feel.
Required to achieve the specific 45-degree shears and integrated speed lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of five Black men in a V-formation against a solid royal blue background. They are wearing oversized royal blue blazers with black turtlenecks. The lighting is soft studio light from the front-left. The central man is looking directly at the camera.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top left corner, add a custom white geometric logo with ultra-condensed vertical letters. Incorporate black horizontal tapering lines that extend from the left edge behind the letters. Add small magenta triangular accents at the mid-points of the letter strokes.

verificationChecks: Is the blue of the suits nearly identical to the background?
Are the letterforms extremely tall and narrow?
Are there horizontal 'speed lines' behind the text?
Is the formation of the men a clear 'V' shape?

adjustableVariables: Specific poses of the group members
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Check for five distinct subjects in the V-formation.
Ensure the typography is white and vertically elongated.
Verify the presence of black horizontal graphic lines in the top left.
Confirm the background is a solid, saturated blue.
Ensure the suits are oversized in 1990s fashion style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + [Color] monochromatic theme + [V-formation] group pose + [Geometric Condensed] typography with [Horizontal Speed Lines].
